Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question’s “what decides” as a predictive inference problem (using siblings’ phenotypes to estimate hidden genotypes) rather than a causal inheritance question. This led to selecting B instead of the genetics-based ground truth A (parents’ hair type/genes determine the trait). The Planner also prematurely marked the task complete without engaging any specialist or verifying the basic genetics principle.
